TIL a woman in England was refused drive-through service due to being on horseback, determined, she went inside, where her horse proceeded to defecate.
TIL that sailors used to pour oil into the ocean during storms to calm the waves, and ships were required to carry "storm oil" for this purpose until the late 20th century.

TIL Candace Newmaker, a 10-year-old girl who died in 2000 during a “rebirthing” treatment meant to cure reactive attachment disorder. She was wrapped in flannel and covered with pillows to simulate a birth canal, and was expected to fight her way out of it, suffocating to death during the treatment.

TIL the last time a supernova was unquestionably visible with the naked eye was in 1604. Known as "Kepler's Supernova", it was so bright it was seen during the day for a period of three weeks. Records of its sighting exist in European, Chinese, Korean, and Arabic sources.
TIL the Alaska Permanent Fund pays residents of Alaska on average $1600 a year.
TIL two pilots flew a Cessna 172 continuously for 64 days, 22 hours and 19 minutes in 1959. Their world record has remained unbeaten for 67 years.
TIL Tadeusz Kościuszko, a Polish engineer, helped Americans beat the British at Saratoga, and went unpaid for 7 years. He then willed his entire US fortune to free enslaved people.

TIL although she dropped out from school at 14, Elena Ceaușescu, wife of Nicolae Ceaușescu, passed herself as an eminent chemistry researcher, getting honorary degrees from both Romanian and foreign colleges and having work ghostwritten by actual scientists
TIL that when a sperm whale gave birth off the coast of Dominica, 10 other whales gathered around her and helped lift the newborn calf out of the water. Not all of them were related to the mother.
TIL that 59% of polled households watched the World Series in 1971. In 2026 it was down to 16%, with a low of 12% in 2012 and 2020
